allow: PowerShell($proxy = "http://127.0.0.1:10808"; foreach \($path in @\("plc/data-format.md","plc/siemens.md"\)\) { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri \("http://www.lecpserver.com:3001/"+$path\) -Proxy $proxy -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; "---$path---"; \($r.Content | Select-String -Pattern "DWord|DWORD|Byte|BYTE|VD|MB|value|type" -CaseSensitive:$false -Context 1,2 | Select-Object -First 40\).ToString\(\) })

PowerShell($targets = @\('http://127.0.0.1:8088','http://localhost:8088'\); foreach \($url in $targets\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; "$url => HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\) $\($r.StatusDescription\)"; $r.Content.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(500,$r.Content.Length\)\) } catch { "$url => $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })
